---
title: "OS Model Fitting"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| output: false
library(fs)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(rstanarm)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_path <- here("0-main-analysis", "OS", "imp-data")
m <- length(dir_ls(data_path))
```

## Create output directory

```{r}
output_dir <- here("0-main-analysis", "OS", "results")
# dir_create(output_dir)
# dir_create(path(output_dir, "models"))
# dir_create(path(output_dir, "survival_curves"))
# dir_create(path(output_dir, "diagnostics"))
# dir_create(path(output_dir, "rmst"))
```

## Fit models and calculate estimand

```{r}
for(i in 1:m) {
    cat("Processing imputation", i, "of", m, "\n")

    data <- read_parquet(here("0-main-analysis", "OS", "imp-data", paste0("os-data-", i, ".parquet")))

    # Calculate mGPS
    data <- data |>
        mutate(
            mgps = factor(case_when(
                c_reactive_protein  <= 10 ~ 0,
                albumin >= 35 ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ 2)),
            ecog_binary = case_when(
                ecog_fstcnt == 0 | ecog_fstcnt == 1 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ 1
            )
        )

    # Define priors
    tx_scale <- 0.55
    default_scale <- 2.5

    prior <- normal(
        location = c(rep(0, 5)),
        scale = c(tx_scale, rep(default_scale, 4))
    )

    # Fit the model
    model <- stan_surv(
        formula = Surv(surv_time, status_death) ~ tx + ecog_binary + lung +
                    mgps,
        data = data,
        basehaz = "ms",
        basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
        prior = prior,
        prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
        prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
        chains = 4,
        cores = 4,
        seed = 68818,
        iter = 4000
    )

    # Save model object
    saveRDS(model, file = path(output_dir, "models", paste0("model_imp_", i, ".rds")))

    # Generate diagnostic plots
    trace_plot <- plot(model, plotfun = "trace")
    ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("trace_imp_", i, ".png")),
           plot = trace_plot,
           width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    dens_plot <- plot(model, plotfun = "dens")
    ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("posterior_imp_", i, ".png")),
           plot = dens_plot,
           width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    # --- Calculate RMST and survival curves ---
    # Get posterior survival curves for tx=0
    ps_0_list <- posterior_survfit(
        model,
        newdata = data |> mutate(tx = 0),
        times = 0,
        extrapolate = TRUE,
        standardise = TRUE,
        control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200),
        return_matrix = TRUE,
        draws = 4000
    )

    std_surv_matrix_0 <- do.call(cbind, ps_0_list)
    time_points <- sapply(ps_0_list, attr, "times")

    # Get posterior survival curves for tx=1
    ps_1_list <- posterior_survfit(
        model,
        newdata = data |> mutate(tx = 1),
        times = 0,
        extrapolate = TRUE,
        standardise = TRUE,
        control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200),
        return_matrix = TRUE,
        draws = 4000
    )
    std_surv_matrix_1 <- do.call(cbind, ps_1_list)

    # Save survival curves
    survival_data <- list(
        time_points = time_points,
        surv_tx0 = std_surv_matrix_0,
        surv_tx1 = std_surv_matrix_1
    )
    saveRDS(survival_data,
            file = path(output_dir, "survival_curves", paste0("surv_curves_imp_", i, ".rds")))

    # Calculate RMST for tx=0 using trapezoidal rule
    delta_t <- diff(time_points)
    s_t1_0 <- std_surv_matrix_0[, -ncol(std_surv_matrix_0)]
    s_t2_0 <- std_surv_matrix_0[, -1]
    trapezoid_areas_0 <- 0.5 * (s_t1_0 + s_t2_0) *
        matrix(delta_t, nrow = nrow(s_t1_0), ncol = length(delta_t), byrow = TRUE)
    rmst_0 <- rowSums(trapezoid_areas_0)

    # Calculate RMST for tx=1
    s_t1_1 <- std_surv_matrix_1[, -ncol(std_surv_matrix_1)]
    s_t2_1 <- std_surv_matrix_1[, -1]
    trapezoid_areas_1 <- 0.5 * (s_t1_1 + s_t2_1) *
        matrix(delta_t, nrow = nrow(s_t1_1), ncol = length(delta_t), byrow = TRUE)
    rmst_1 <- rowSums(trapezoid_areas_1)

    # Calculate the difference
    rmst_diff <- rmst_1 - rmst_0

    # Combine and save RMST results
    rmst_results <- data.frame(
        imputation = i,
        rmst_0 = rmst_0,
        rmst_1 = rmst_1,
        rmst_diff = rmst_diff
    )
    write_parquet(rmst_results,
                  path(output_dir, "rmst", paste0("rmst_imp_", i, ".parquet")))

    cat("Completed imputation", i, "\n\n")
}
```
